Was happy with the results just wish the light would of kept working. Probably won't sleep very well because I got use to it lighting up my living room.

title: Unsure
review: It does not seem to be working so will move it to another place and sees what happens there.

title: zevo insect trap
review: not impressed did not work well

title: worked ok
review: worked ok

title: It’s ok
review: I got this mostly for mosquitos which it said it can catch . I have not seen any mosquitos on it . That being said there are flies and other bugs which is nice to see . It’s small and takes only one plug . The thing I feel bad about is that the bugs are not killed by it they just get stuck and slowly die which feels a little evil

title: Bug be gone
review: Appears to be working as it should

title: Large
review: How much room you need above the electric socket for the height of this unit. I had to put it the 4th socket because it is to big.

title: Why Produce More Plastic than Necessary
review: This product works. But when you buy a refill, you toss the plastic shield and the thin layer of bug killer attached to it, thereby requiring yet another plastic shield to push into the device after sticking the bug killer to it. I just cannot see myself using this much plastic. I imagine resin could be used to make the shield and a thin layer of resin to which the sticky killer could be attached. To require the customer buy refills that are in a box with only 2 refills per box is asking a bit much. If one were able to buy 10 thin layers of resin with just a thin layer of resin one could then pull off and attach to the original it would be so much more sustainable. In the commercial, the person chucks the whole thing in the trash…just such waste. More thinking needs to be done on the materials used.

title: It works but needs time
review: Initially, I was almost ready to send it back because I was still being bothered by the little insects flying insects, but I’ve just realized that it was placed under under the kitchen cabinets swipe up. OK let me move it out more in the open and it seems to be working so I’m planning to keep it plugged in and I’ll see how many more I will gather in there because they obviously are annoying so that’s my review. . If you put it in the kitchen don’t put it under the cabinets.

title: careful placement of device is important
review: I am using it to catch fruit flies. In it's first location it was totally ineffective. When I moved it next to the counter where I prepare food, it became more effective. To get maximum effectiveness I have to be careful to immediately wash my work area after each use and put bug spray in my closed trash can which the tiny bugs can get into.

title: Not super effective for me
review: These aren’t really working for me. I bought two of them and one has a few flies and the other is completely empty after two weeks. And I still have fruit flies flying around my apartment. The instructions are easy to follow and they’re easy to install but I’m a little disappointed with the efficacy. I know others who’ve had better luck with this so I’m not sure why it’s not working as well for me

title: Garbage for sink flies
review: I had high hopes for this since the reviews were promising. I plugged it in and have had it for 5 days now and it’s not attracted a single insect! And there’s plenty of sink flies roaming around, they today ignore this junk. Save your money on this one

title: Anser the question, Do they work.
review: Received on December 3 and installed, today is December 12th and they have yet to trap or catch a single fruit fly. After day 3 I got out my bowl and filled it 1/2 way with apple cider vinegar, made a cover of aluminum foil punched some small holes in the foil. Since then it has captured 17 fruit flies and the traps still have caught none. If you purchase I hope you have better luck with them than I had.

title: Not effective except as nightlight
review: installed three days ago , and if I were to box it up right now , it would pass for new . the transparent protective pieces were removed and units plugged into outlets, all other lights off at night . NOTHING trapped! going back

title: ….. at least the light is pretty??
review: They make great night lights for children, but that wasn’t what I bought them for 🫠 Not a single fly was caught, these did not work for me at all.

title: Overhyped waste of time
review: Not sure where all these positive reviews are coming from, this product is not good at all. After 2 days, the fruit flies do not fly in this thing, even after putting them next to the sources of infestation and leaving it on all night. 4 of them are strategically placed in the household, and the old Apple cider vinegar trick works 100 times better. Don't fall for the hype; this product, in my opinion, is junk. Just a few here and there landed on the sticky film.

title: Sadly not trapping
review: The fruit fly trap has not capture any in 3 days. They fly near the trap but continue to avoid. I had high hopes for it working

title: Never caught a single one
review: These things suck. For some weird reason I have knats in my kitchen. Kitchen is very clean so I have no idea where they keep coming from. I tried these and haven't caught a single one. It's been a week. I have to use a spray then reclean everything. No food sitting out. All I can think of is they are coming from sink. Even poured bleach in all drains. Guess I'll stick with the kid/pet safe spray.

title: DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY!!!!
review: I bought a pair of these thinking that they would be good and attract gnats instead didn’t attract anything total waste of money

title: It does not work. It does the opposite
review: So I bought this because I have fruit flies in the house. This is a joke. They fly by it I even lured them to the bananas it doesn’t work. I waited a whole day 24 hours. Nothing even at night when that is the only light they see. I wasted my money. I’m researching to see another product that works. There isn’t any smell (I can’t smell anything) and they certainly are not attract it to it. They avoid it because they would normally go to the bananas and if I put them close to the thingy they don’t get near it lol. They should sell it as a repellent not a trap

title: Terrible product.
review: Have had these for a little while now and it doesn't work at all have gnats still not a single one has gone to this trap!!!
This worked for my fruit flies but not the bigger flies, all in all it partially did what it advertised for the smaller flies.

title: Effective for small flying insects
review: It's easy to set up, doesn't use chemicals, and is quiet enough to leave on overnight. I like that it looks clean and modern compared to other bug traps I've had. The only downside is that it doesn't attract every insect type some gnats and fruit flies seem to avoid it. Also, the tray for dead insects is a bit small and needs frequent emptying if you have a lot of bugs.

title: Pricey
review: Too expensive for refills, but it does work to reduce about 60% of bugs

title: Item not as described.
review: Works, but only received 2 replacement cartridges instead of the stated 3.

title: Partially Worked
review: It did trap a few very small flying insects but we had a fly that got in through an open door and even after 24 hours it did not trap it.

title: Box damaged
review: The product itself is good but the box came open/ripped. Like someone had returned it and they didn't even bother to repackage it.

title: Ineffective
review: Edit to update: After two weeks, there are 10-12 gnats stuck to the pad. Still no flies or other insects. I had high hopes for this unit. The pads are extremely sticky so I just knew this was going to the solution to our problems in out motorhome. Flies making their way into the motohome during the summer months is just inevitable. We use pest control spray and other means of deterrents when staying in campgrounds, but flies still become an issue. I installed these 48 hours ago and there hasn't been a fly caught yet. I type this as 2 flies are zipping around my head driving me crazy. Based on this, I would say these aren't effective and would not be repurchasing.

title: MEH.
review: My experience with this product is mediocre. Yes, it attracts very young fruit flies; however, older fruit flies totally ignore the blue light. Also, we don't have many flies here, so the traps effectiveness against those pests is unknown.

title: Not sure if it is worth it
review: Not sure if I like it just yet. I just moved into an apartment that seems to attract gnats. I purchased it and it has only caught 2 so far. Not sure if it is working as well as I would like it too. It is a nice look and doesn’t look out of place. It is pretty tall and easy to use.

title: not terribly effective for fruit flys
review: I bought this specifically for fruit flys. Unfortunately it did little to help the issue. I reverted to the old stand by of apple cider vinigar and a couple of drops of dishwashing liquid.

title: The old beats the new
review: A small bowl of apple cider vinegar, covered with plastic wrap with a few small holes pocked in it, will catch many more fruit flies than this $20. Contraption. I am very disappointed in it. There are probably 50 fruit flies in my vinegar and 7 in the Zevo.

title: Not a fly catcher
review: I purchased this product with the hopes of it catching regular house flies along with gnats. We'll, if fell short of my expectations. I literally had house flies 10 inches away from where it was plugged in...nothing..this thing did not catch any house flies. It did catch gnats. But, I can pay much less to get a 30 pack of sticky gnat Father's. So, do not purchased this item expecting it to catch house flies.

title: Works well but light does not last very long.
review: I works well. Caught a lot of fruit flies. However, this is the second one I've bought that has burned out within about 3 months. Doesn't seem like the light is replaceable either which is disappointing.

title: Comments on fly trap
review: I am not impressed with this, I should have taken note of the size. a big blue light that I find annoying. But most of all… I am not getting any of the gnats flying into the thing. Not worth the money I spent. Got better results with ACV in a dish.

title: Light burned out quickly
review: Works great for catching fruit flies. However, light burned out within 5 weeks. Threw it in the trash.

title: Only received this product 24 hours ago!
review: I only received this yesterday and it is catching flies. At this point there are still many more to be caught.

title: Not that great
review: These are not going to get the job done if you have a full blown infestation. Maybe good for everyday use and keeping fruit flies away in general if you notice a couple flying around but has only caught about 10 after 4 days. I got the Terri Fruit Fly Trap and that worked way better.

title: Not as effective as I'd hoped.
review: So far my apple cider vinegar and dish soap works better. After about 4 hours there were 2 fruit flies in the zevo trap which was plugged in about 18 inches from kitchen sink.

title: Cost
review: I bought this item because I have some little mats in the bathroom. It seems to work most of the time but then every once in a while you’ll see one flying around so could it be better yeah maybe

title: Not for fruit flies!
review: Doesn’t catch fruit flies just attracts them, works well with regular flies though.

title: Zero, If Only It Was More Effective
review: Until I see if 3 of these plug ins starts catching more of those tiny flies, probably gnats or fruit flies, I can't make a firm decision about how effective they're really! There's now 3 plugins in my kitchen, only had 1, and there's quite a few stuck to it, but to me, it's not that effective to attract them but maybe I just had 1 of them plugged in, as we will see. Today June 12, Saturday 2025, was when I added the other two❗️Will update this ASAP! Gary and Brandy in Kaneohe Hawaii My poor Brandy dealing with me, getting angry with insects!

title: Does the job
review: Expensive, but it's nice that you can't see the bugs until you change the refill.

title: Not great at catching house flies.
review: It does okay at catching smaller bugs, fruit flies, gnats. But it doesn’t really attract house flies which is why I bought it so kinda disappointed.

title: Average performance
review: These didn't work as well as the home made apple cider vinegar solution.

title: less messy than sticky fly strips- same effect
review: meh. works alright. certainly more attractive BUT not any more productive than everyday fly tape rolls, for the price.

title: It works as a backup
review: We recently had a fruit fly infestation at our house due to a rotting onion we did not notice. The house was pretty bad in two rooms, so we ordered a couple of products. One was this item the other was a trap that you fill with an apple vinegar solution. Between the two, the trap with the solution was the clear winner and within a couple of days our house was under control. I did check the Zevo trap and we did have a few flies, but no where near what the other trap performed. I think this trap is an OK solution to have working passively during the summer months, but if you have a larger problem, it may not be sufficient.

title: Patience needed but they work.
review: First day: 0 Second day: 3 Third: 40 Fourth: 50 Then: still trying to get a few

title: Viral fly trap review
review: The fly situation in my house has gotten out of hand so I finally decided to try these viral fly traps. Honestly I’m pretty disappointed with the effectiveness given how expensive these are and seeing all these videos in the internet of how great they work. Yes they do catch flys but I’m still seeing a lot of flys/fruit flys in my house despite having two in my kitchen and one in every room in my house. They are really expensive for the value I feel like my apple cider vinegar DIY trap catches more bugs?? They definitely work on a smaller scale but not if you have a real fruit fly issue

title: Works okay
review: It does attract gnats, but it takes awhile. The gnats sometimes are not attracted to the trap.

title: Doesn't attract most fruit flies
review: Works somewhat, but a lot of the fruit flies don't go near the light. Maybe it works better if you have all the lights out at night.

title: Bad with house flies
review: We have an issue with house flies. I plugged in my Zevo next to my kitchen sink where I have had may issues with bug. I also placed a piece of cheap sticky paper on a window. I was surprised at how poorly it did against the cheap sticky tape after 24 hours. It didn’t catch a single house fly, I would not recommend it for house flies, but it did catch 2 fruit flies so it did something, just not what I wanted it to do.

title: Great night light!
review: Unfortunately, I’m not impressed by this product. I bought 2, Gnats or flies have not been attracted to this very bright light trap! Will not be buying again. Positive is its easy to install, has a sticky coating on the inside of light.

title: So far, not impressed
review: So far, after a week, I am less than impressed. With it being summer time and having 4 kids in the house, there are always doors left open and there is always the random fly or 3 that gets in. Saw this on a commercial and we decided to give it a try with zero success. I am not to the point of returning this yet, but I am definitely watching the calendar to stay under the 30 day return window. Unfortunate.

title: Did not work
review: No attraction to the little flys in my home. I tried different locations. I have (2) plugged into kitchen outlets. One is directly above a fresh fruit bowl, bananas, tomatoes, peaches, etc. did not catch anything. Fruit flys still in my kitchen.

title: Doesn't Attract Flies
review: Product technically works, in that it is sticky enough to trap flies, but it doesn't attract them at all. We had a room full of them, with that being the only light in the room, and it only managed to catch 2 overnight. It's definitely not worth the money.

title: Very pretty, not as effective as apple cider vinegar for fruit flies
review: Returning from vacation, I had a fruit fly infestation. So I bought 2 Zevo units to deal with the problem. When I noticed that the fruit flies seemed to be still abundant, I started a cup with apple cider vinegar and dish soap. I estimate that the vinegar/soap mixture has caught 40-50 flies while the Zevo unit has caught 4 flies. I admit that the Zevo unit looks better and smells better, but it really is not dealing with the problem.

title: Didn't work for fruit flies
review: This did not work for me. Left plugged in for days while fruit flies multiplied. This caught maybe 3 or 4. Bought a couple $1 fruit fly traps from the D.G. and all the flies were gone in 24 hours.

title: Good for flying insects but not as effective for mosquitoes.
review: Does a great job of attracting and trapping moths, gnats other flying insects, it is NOT effective for attracting mosquitoes…it turns out lab studies have concluded that mosquitoes are not attracted to blue UV light, but they are attracted to me and my blood type. I had put the Zevo in place for 2 weeks indoors in several locations and the 1-2 mosquito(es) still had command of my indoor space.

title: Not many bugs attracted
review: Decent but doesn't attract many bugs

title: Good for regular flies.Does not work on fruit flies
review: Good for regular flies.Does not work on fruit flies

title: Looks good on paper
review: This product looked good so I ordered some to control a healthy population of fruit and/or drain flies living in my kitchen. They have caught a few but only a small percentage of the annoying thins. A minor aid, perhaps but nowhere near close to a solution.

title: A bad smell.
review: Why did you pick this product vs others?: Not sure. There is a strange smell that comes off these fly traps. It woke me up at 2 am in the morning. I had to go and unplug them and take them out in the garage. The smell was choking. I don't know what it was but I did not like it. The nearest one to me in my bedroom was 200 feet away, but the smell came through the whole house carried with the air conditioner not happy not happy at all did not expect them to have a smell like that. Not scented not burning but a sort of bug killer smell. Cannot explain but will not EVER use again.

title: Expensive glue trap
review: They work ok but I ended up buying a comparatively priced bug zapper that will still be working years from now.

title: Save your money
review: Hasn't trapped anything yet . The fruit flies don't seem to care that it is on . I would NOT recommend this item . Save your money

title: No cartridges with the Zevo Flying Insect traps
review: I just started using the Zev flying insect traps. After seeing a commercial on TV, I noticed that my devices were not lighting up. After further investigation, I discovered they did not have the Cartridges with them and they were not in the box. Luckily, I had purchased a box of 4 refills or these would have been useless. I can not return them because I threw away the original packing. I guess I’m out the cost of the 2 cartridges that did not come with my original purchase.

title: It works sometimes
review: It does work but not always. Pricey. It depends where you place it..

title: Order Incomplete. Manufacturer wants proof instead of believing me.
review: I did not get a complete order. Cartridges were missing. When I wrote them, they wanted proof. The proof would be a photo of the order without the cartridge. Were I cheating, I could simply take a picture that excluded the cartridges. I assume that is obvious so what would proof be?

title: After online research, the blue light illumination is defective or dies in many plug in devices.
review: First product shipment only 1 of 2 plug in devices worked. The blue light did not illuminate and had to return the entire package. Replacements work and I was able to return originals. Disappointed because by the time I received replacements the weather changed and I did not have as many bugs trying to sneak into my house. Only a few have been caught on the sticky trap of each. It did not happen within the first 24 hours as advertised.

title: Zevo 2 flying insect traps
review: They are OK, but they do not work as advertised. I still see flies buzzing around the house and I had to go online and purchase an old-fashioned flyswatter to get these pesky flies that kept buzzing in my ear when I’m working remotely for that day and my hybrid job.

title: Ineffective indoor trap
review: Getting a lot of Boxelder in the house, the ZEVO didn't help very much. After one week the ZEVO got 2 or 3 bugs in it. Do not recommend it for this type of insects.

title: Zevo gimmick
review: I wanted to love this product but it has let me down. I have maybe 3-7 gnats over a month now. ( 2 zevo plugged into the kitchen) I have killed more with the apple cider vinegar and dish detergent dish. ☹️ In my opinion this was an expensive gimmick

title: Need support on the ZEVO and how it works because I still have tons of gnats flying around
review: Not as effective as I thought it would be. Still have knats in the air, not sure what to use for them, to get attracked to the ZEVO

title: Worse than I thought amazing!
review: They seem to be doing everybody else, but I keep getting all over my body that is exposed just the air. I can’t remember the actual name of the fly, but the name is the “fly.

title: Does not catch house flies, homemade solution worked equally as well
review: We set 2 of these devices in our kitchen along with a shallow bowl with a solution of vinegar & dish soap. after 3 days we caught equal amounts of small phorid flies in all three traps and no house flies even though a few were seen in the area. Save $40 and use the homemade solution, it works equally well.

title: Not working for gnats
review: So I've had 2 of these active for over a week. I'm targeting fruit flys/ gnats. They're still flying around with no open food in my office. I looked behind both of the traps and there still is not even one stuck on the sticky backing. I'm frustrated. Product description says it works for fruit flying and gnats

title: Check the contents before using.
review: Received the “Zevo 2 Flying Insect Traps & 2 Refill Cartridges” bundle box. BUT the 2 refill cartridges were not there. We had already opened the two traps and installed cartridges before realizing the refills were missing. Zevo traps works as they should. 1 star for the Zevo traps and 1 star for the quick delivery.

title: doesn't catch the flying bugs I have
review: I have one of these by my front door and the other in the kitchen, near where I unload and prep all my produce. But the fruit flies and other small flying insects that often hitch a ride inside on your produce just aren't attracted to them. I've had them up for almost 2 weeks and they've only caught a couple of tiny bugs. At this rate, the 4 replacement filters I bought will last a lifetime!

title: Have to have wall plugs only?
review: I am so disappointed with these I love I an older house which has limited outlets we’ll input extension o yhemtried o oils but don stand up so these are not useable as they have to be pugged in a socket on wall to be effective dose not explain this on advertisement really does not work hanging used down now I have find somthing that works elly dissapointed Elizabeth.

title: Not worth the money!!!
review: Not worth the money!! I set up vinegar trap & this trap right next to each other. Zero trap caught 5 fruit flies while traditional homemade vinegar trap caught at least 30-50.

title: bugless.
review: Set two of these on kitchen counter for gnats and fruit flies. After 5 days only had two bugs in one trap and one in the other. not very effective.

title: Looks nice - not super effective
review: We’ve had this for about a week and a half now. Our house has a ton of flies in it. So far this has only been able to catch about two Nats in one fly. We’ve been having to swap most of the flies out of the sky. The ZEVO looks nice but it hasn’t been super effective in our house.

title: Did… basically nothing?
review: I was really hoping this would help with the gnat situation in my kitchen, but honestly, it didn’t do much. I left it plugged in 24/7 for days—right in the kitchen where the little bugs hang out—and it only caught a few here and there. Definitely not enough to justify the hype. I figured the light would attract more, but it just… didn’t. Kind of surprised honestly, especially seeing how many glowing reviews this thing has. Maybe I got a dud? Or maybe it just doesn't work that well. It looks nice, and I like that it’s mess-free and chemical-free, but beyond that? Not impressed.

title: Not impressed.
review: I have another companies version of this product type that is superior to Zevo’s version. I owned it first but thought I’d give s vo a try. The rounded sticky pad and design is not as effective as capturing insects and this product is 2x’s the cost. It works, it just doesn’t work well and if I hadn’t opened and used the product I’d return it. If you could find a flat version, same principle, I’d go with that one because it works much better!

title: Prick good missing items.
review: Like the product but when I received it the box was broken into and 2 refills missing. Needed them so I did not return.

title: Not good
review: I have fruit flies swarming in my her. It happens every year. They come in from the septic system. I had zappers that helped but not enough, so I thought I try Zevo. It didn’t work. I had both sitting side by side and the zappers worked better. It only caught a handful of flies when I have many dozens swarming near by. Not good at catching flies.

title: Catches gnats well but not if you want to catch mosquitos...
review: I bought this because I wanted to capture and kill annoying mosquitos in my home, but I guess the mosquitos were too smart and I only caught some gnats. I ended up returning this item since it did not suit my intended purpose of CAPTURING MOSQUITOS.... GAHHHH!!! It also can suit as a night light if you do decide to keep this item.

title: Flystrips worked better
review: I put them in places that would attract more of the Nats, which is what we had happening and hardly any Nats got on it. I just got me some fly strips and cut more than the product gave us.

title: Not sure it works
review: 2 stars because it looks nice. Not sure it works bc haven’t trapped anything. I still see pests flying around

title: Does Not Seem to Catch Anything
review: So far it does not seem to work well at all. Have a few flies in the house and they are still buzzing around. Will try to move it around and give it a few more days but prospect for catching any insects seems low.

title: Not happy with these traps at all!
review: Very misleading. Advertising says 2 traps + 2 refills! To me, it sounded like you got 2 complete traps + 2 refills. Not so! You get two complete traps and no refills. Plus they don’t work that well! Sorry I bought these!

title: Pesky Pests
review: Had a pesky fly for a few days and ordered these for the little pest! 3 days that thing was plugged in and that fly never went near it! I finally caught him on my front door and opened it for him to escape. The zevo trap is still clean, I gave it 2 stars because the blue light is pretty but it does not work as advertized!

title: Was really hoping it worked
review: Attracted a few moths. Moved it around trying different places with no better results.

title: Too Bright
review: I knew this worked with a light but I had no idea the light would be as bright as it is. I sleep in a room that is susceptible to flies and mosquitoes (for a variety of reasons) and this device is so bright in the dark that it's ridiculous. The other device was plugged in to an outlet on my back porch (also susceptible to flies, etc. since I go in and out frequently to garden) and I like to sit there at night to enjoy the night sounds, etc. The brilliant blue light is ridiculous. I had both devices plugged in for 24 hours and one collected a gnat while a fly few around and the other collected nothing --also while a fly few around. So between the brightness and the less than stellar performance, I'm returning it. Unrelated to the product, I have to mention the packaging.

title: Don’t waste your money
review: 10 days since I made this purchase, wish I could get my money back. The blue light does literally nothing to attract bugs- and the adhesive does not actually trap the bugs, just hassles them and detains them like a bad traffic stop. Save your money, clean your damn space.

title: Didn't catch very many flies
review: The product looks nice, but doesn't seem to catch any flies. It does however, catch many other insects such as mosquitos.

title: Not good for flies
review: Had an issue with flies in my house so bought two. Did not catch one single fly. A few moths but that’s about it.

title: Xxx
review: 4-5 days is not a good test

title: My fruitflies must be too smart for this....
review: I read a lot of the reviews and thought this was a no-brainer as we occasionally have a fruit fly party in our kitchen....packaging was good, setup was super easy, delivery was fast The first day/night I used this I saw that we had maybe 1 fruit fly that was caught....so I actually moved a small bowl of fruit, peels, etc that the flies were in directly under the Zevo and shut off all of the other lights in the kitchen. I left the bowl there for a couple days while the fruit flies were literally walking around the Zevo and hanging out on the outlet....after about a week of using this, I may have caught 10 fruit flies and probably doubled the population doing things to try and capture them. Not impressed and will be returning

title: Florida flies are immune
review: Two stars because two flies is all that we caught. The other six flies avoided both traps in stealth-like flight patterns and ultimately were taken down with an old-fashioned fly swat. Zevo $37.47, fly swatter $0.99. I wouldn't waste your money.

title: Great Idea but not good enough
review: Have this for 2 weeks. Haven't captured other flys like others I have used. Did collect some fruit flys. One in kitchen other in landry room. Both issue. If it doesn't collect better will send back since it cost so mich money.

title: Not great
review: Having an issue with fruit flys in my apartment, bought the 2 pack of Zevo. After 2 weeks, they've trapped maybe 4 out of 100+ fruit flys. Only positive is the nice blue nightlight

title: The fly isn't interested in this trap, prefers my head
review: I had hoped that the Zevo would trap this annoying fly buzzing around my head and reading light this morning. I ordered the product just for this situation! But the trap does not interest my big noisy fly--it avoids the trap and just keeps circling my head. What a dumb fly. I'm so disappointed in it.

title: Does not work
review: Doesn’t work, placed two near where fruit flies and gnats where seen. Two days and no captures. Absolutely no insects captured!

title: Hit or miss
review: Unfortunately we purchased these because we seem to have a moth infestation for every three four moths I catch,... in a few days there's double that so we purchased this item in the hopes that it would take care of the issue but to my surprise, no... there will be a moth right next to the z e v o plug-in,.. as if it's laughing at me! And then a few others on the wall a few feet away or across the room, the only lucky thing is that I catch him with a vacuum cleaner. So I guess this is a not so good review.

title: Doesn't really do much. Fly swatter does a better job
review: They said to wait about 2 weeks and so far I'm at 1 week with only 3 fruit flies. I keep it near our non refrigerated fruits like bananas to help but it hasn't done much.

title: Isn't working.
review: Product works best in dark spaces (as listed) due to UV light being what attracts flying insects. Isn't that where activity is at its least? I have two of them in dimly lit spaces in my kitchen and living room right now and they have trapped nothing so far. Can't recommend. Two stars because at least it tells you it works best in dark spaces.

title: Over priced but really good product
review: Over priced i bought a 2 trap 4 refill set for 10 dollars less than this sellers price. The product itself is amazing !

title: Not a good purchase.
review: Noticed a few bugs caught but the majority still remained. Tried different locations with no better results. Would not purchase again.

title: Fair

title: I wouldn’t purchase again
review: I’ve seen ads for this product for a while so it immediately came to mind as a solution when we started having a fruit fly problem. I like the concept of this product but felt it wasn’t as effective as it should have been. I placed it where I had seen most of the fruit flies hanging out and it did catch a few, but I was a little disappointed that it wasn’t making much of a dent in the population. Something else I should have considered before purchasing was how brightly the blue light shines from this device. We avoid blue light around bedtime and dim the lights in our house in the evenings as we get ready to sleep and so this didn’t fit with my personal sleep hygiene preferences - but that’s honestly my fault for not thinking through how this product works before purchasing it. After giving Zevo a chance for a few days I decided to try the old apple cider vinegar in a jar with tiny holes poked in the lid method. The apple cider jar was the clear winner and captured at least 3-4 times more in a single night than the Zivo had in days. The homemade method was much cheaper too. If I could go back and do it all over again I would just do the jar trick and save money by not purchasing this product.

For the price, I was disappointed with the results. On the plus side, it’s easy to set up and looks clean and safe around kids and pets—but effectiveness was lacking for gnats or fruit flies in my case. title: Product Description is Deceptive!
review: The description states 2 Plug-in Bases + 2 Refill Cartridges. You expect that with the 2 Plug-In Bases you would get the Cartridges and 2 refills. You only get the bases no cartridges in the bases. The description is very tricky to read as your expecting the Plug-In bases to have everything to just plug the unit in and it will contain the fly trap. It does not come ready to use, you have to insert the "Refill Cartridge", so you only get 2 Plug-ins and no inserts, you have to use your refills, only then is it ready to use, the description is deceptive. In my opinion its shorting you 2 cartridges. In order to resolve this "Description Issue", Amazon or the Seller should change the description to "Zevo Flying Insect Trap, Fly Trap, Fruit Fly Trap (2 Plug-in Bases + 2 (Refill should be removed), Cartridges). This way the consumer will get a complete product and without "Refills".

title: Nice-looking, simple concept but poor design
review: The concept of these traps is simple and typically very effective at catching flying insects. We've used similar products with excellent results and I am fairly sure these would have also worked quite well. However, I ended up returning these and buying the Safer Home traps, which looks very similar to these because these have a (completely unnecessary IMO) ON/OFF button on them that does not remember what state it was in, so every single time the power goes out, even for the shortest amount of time, I have to go around and press the button on every trap to turn them back on. Seriously people, why??? It's an insect trap and its job is to be on catching insects, so why overcomplicate things by adding an ON/OFF button? And if you really must have an ON/OFF button, make it mechanical, so it will stay in the current state. Initially when I plugged the first one in, I thought it didn't work, then realized it had that button, which is not that noticeable (and you know I didn't read the instructions). Also, while I still think these would work, I feel that the LEDs on this trap are not as effective as those on the Safer Home units and these seemed to light up the room more, even though the LEDs don't seem as bright (I think they are a slightly lower wavelength of UV than the Safer Home units use. In any case, I cannot recommend this product due to the above, as there are other choices that are better designed and work exceptionally well in the same price range.

review: So I have mixed feelings on this… the good: crazy sticky adhesive area, soft and not blinding light, the adjustable plug that allows you to install it in outlets that run both horizontally and vertically, quick set up, and safe for my pets and kids with no harsh chemicals or zaps of electricity. I also really appreciate the additional pack of sticky pads that comes with it - there’s nothing worse than getting a great product that has a replaceable element and then discovering that you’ve got to shell out more money if you want to continue to use it down the road. The bad: it’s kind of a statement piece- it’s pretty big, and that mixed with the purple light does make it a bit of an eyesore and very noticeable as soon as you walk in the room. I’m also not sure how well the purple light works, because the 3 fruit flies who have decided to invade my kitchen still haven’t gotten themselves stuck to the pad yet. I was expecting it to work a little quicker and for the little buggers to be firmly attached to the sticky part by now, but I haven’t given up hope that one day soon I’ll be greeted by beautiful silence instead of a slight buzz when I walk into my kitchen.

title: Stopped working; *WARRANTY* promise but NO! support channel
review: I purchased the FVOAI Fruit Fly Trap in March 2025. It worked at first, then sat powered off for about four months. Today did not turn on. After checking with its own, I tried multiple USB adapters and cables; pressing the power button does nothing—no lights, no response. The bigger issue is support. The email listed on the brand’s site (contact at thefvoai dot com ) bounced (Gmail delivery failure), and the phone number on their site did not connect to a working support line. There was no support contact in the Amazon listing or inside the box brochure—even though the brochure promises: “If you Experience ny Issues with your device this (one yera period) we will be more than happy to replace it free of charge.” I had to hunt down their website just to try contacting them—and even that didn’t work. I understand products can fail. But a warranty is only as good as the ability to reach the company. I’ve wasted time troubleshooting and chasing dead contacts. If FVOAI provides a real channel and resolves this, I will update. Until then, consider the risk that you may be on your own if something goes wrong.

title: This went from a 5-Star to a 1-Star... review updated
review: When I first received this, I was truly amazed! (Original review below) But today - 31 days after purchasing - my review has gone from a 5-Star to a 4-Star. It lasted 30 days and on day 31 it died! After recommending this product to all my friends, I am now telling them to avoid it. The gnats were out of control this season—absolutely driving me crazy. In a moment of desperation, I took a chance and ordered this Star Trek looking trap. I plugged it in and set it on my desk, hoping for the best. A few hours later… nothing. The trap looked completely empty. I’ll admit—I was skeptical. But then this morning, I sat down at my desk and realized something amazing: I was gnat-free. I opened the trap and couldn’t believe my eyes—tons of those annoying little pests were stuck to the bottom! This thing works. It may not look like much at first, but give it a night and let it do its thing. I highly recommend it to anyone battling gnats, mosquitoes, or their sanity. P.S. I chose not to upload a picture because it's pretty gross!

review: I really wanted this to work. We have a legit fly issue seasonally, where we are swatting like 20 a day for nearly a month. We tried to make it work, several location, but we watched flies zip all around it without going in. Literally NONE went it! Maybe because we are in Colorado at altitude? Whatever the case, they simply ignored it... kind of amazingly well. Anyways, it's well built, fairly quiet, looks good. It would be 5 stars if the flies actually went in. After a few weeks with nothing on the sticky pad we returned it.

title: Absolutely worth it. - EDIT: Reduced stars for low longevity
review: Edit: I'm still sold on the functionality of these things. The design is absolutely AWESOME! But the clear plastic ring that holds the LEDs gets cloudy and opaque after a while, and stops attracting the bugs. I'm super disappointed. I took one apart earlier today to see if there was anything I could do about it, but everything I did only made it worse. I might buy a 3D printer just so I can make some new ones because the design REALLY rocks on this thing when the LEDs aren't blocked by the bad choice in plastic. Side note: They're not really meant to be user serviceable, so I wouldn't expect anyone to be making replacement parts. If they could just make that white plastic ring out of something that doesn't get cloudy over time - I think they'd crush all their competition. Original review below for posterity. I got this and another of a different style at the same time. The other one is nowhere near as good as this. In just two days this thing caught all the stuff in the picture. I legit didn't even know I had full size goes flies in the house. The other style only had 2 fruit flies after 3 days. I highly recommend this style, as it's proved highly effective. Definitely more bang for your buck. In addition to the flies, and fruit flies this thing also catches moths. Absolutely recommend getting this, or one just like it.

title: Works, just not fast enough.
review: For the most part this trap works as promised. The light is good and bright and it changes colors as indicated. The fan inside is pretty strong, I can feel it if I put my hand up to it. It does make a buzzing noise but it is not intrusive, we have every fan in the house going at all times so it just joins the background noise. The sticky pads are super sticky and I like that is fairly compact. On the first day it caught about 15 fruit flies day two it cought another 15-20. That wasn't quite fast enough for me since we had thousands in our kitchen so I added a bit of sourdough starter to the middle of the sticky pad to attract them and now it catches about 50 per day. This alone isn't going to get rid of your gnats if you are in the middle if an infestation. It is a good aid but you should pour bleach in your faucets and put treatment in your plant soil also.

review: Listed as a mosquito trap. Zero mosquitos. Just a stupid gadget. Very disappointed. Two stars for the few fruit flies it did catch.

title: Doesn't really work for fruit flies
review: Every year we have a fruit fly issue at our cottage in Northern MI. There are many orchards and vineyards in the area and no matter how careful we are, we get some fruit flies each season. This year we happened to be at the cottage when we had a big outbreak. After a week of temps in the mid 80s, we had a weather shift, dropping the overnight temps into the low 60s with very little wind. The next morning fruit does were everywhere, presumably drawn to the heat of the house. They were outside, inside, everywhere. We rent this cottage and the UV trap had already been use for two weeks before we arrived. There were a few random insects but nothing terribly impressive. When the fruit flies hit, I put out several traditional bait traps. The photos show the difference. At the time of the photos, the UV trap had been in steady operation for 3 weeks. The red/ fruit trap was only out for 2 hours!!! I'm not kidding and not exaggerating. This is two hours. There are two issues here. (1) Fruit flies don't seem particularly attracted to UV light and (2) the suction of the fan isn't remotely adequate.

title: Noisy after a few months of usage
review: We really enjoyed using our FVOAI insect trap since we live in a humid city apartment that attracts many gnats and fruit flies. The trap worked well and did the job. However, after only a few months of usage, the quiet humming noise has now become much louder and the entire trap vibrates, making it difficult to have in a room without causing disruption. We are unsure what caused it to be this way since we only ever turn it on/off and leave it in one place. It’s too noisy to use. I tried searching for a way to contact FVOAI through Amazon and their website to see if I could get it replaced, but it doesn’t look like there’s any way to do so after the initial 30-day window. Unfortunate since we really liked this product but now are unable to continue using it due to the sudden malfunction.

Some do get stuck but its only two or three out of ten. The max run time is 12 hours. After 12 hours when it turns off any trapped fruit flies fly right back out and are back in the house. As soon as you turn it off they start flying back out. So you can't turn it off and try to release them outside. I don't understand how this item made it out of trail testing and into full production.

title: Omg what can I say?! I was so skeptical. This thing WORKS!
review: I know how helpful pictures are for believability, so I’ll attach one! Don’t judge me, I had no idea what these were for the first couples of weeks. So yes they overran my house for a bit. But that is no longer! We are now free from the clutches of these nasty little 💩’s.I recently moved to Florida, and never in my life had I experienced so many (what I thought were gnats - I’m still unsure what the hell they actually are 😂). For the life of me I couldn’t figure out where the swarms of these pesky little things were coming from. I am originally from up north, where the only things that resemble them that we get are fruit flies. I couldn’t figure out why they were everywhere when none of my fruit was rotten or even remotely bad. Until I did some googling and found out these little demons are called Drain Flies. They live and breed in your drain, lay eggs and come out in SWARMS. I tried every remedy to kill them off. I cleaned my drains, I poured all kinds of chemicals down there. I googled every which way to kill their eggs, catch them. Tried the whole apple cider vinegar, water and soap trick. Where the apple cider vinegar is supposed to attract them, and the surface tension of the soap is supposed to get them stuck and they sink into the water below….noooope! Nothing worked. I’d still see them flying all over the place in my peripheral vision, and to top it off I now had a nasty little vinegar cup hidden in my corner smelling like dooky. I, like every other rational person, ran to Amazon for a solution. And I found LOTS of them. My first go to was going to be that light and fan thing, where the light attracts them and the fan supposedly sucks them in to their demise. I really didn’t care which one I purchased, as long as it worked. I saw the reviews and pictures of this one and figured I’d give it a go, and if this one didn’t work, I’d try the other one I mentioned.Day 1, the first few hours, it caught absolutely nothing. And I thought “greaaat. This thing isn’t going to catch anything and I’m gong to have to deal with this pests for another few days while I wait on another order”Day 2. I woke up, not expecting to find anything, and lo and behold, there were 10-15 flies on it. My prayers had been answered!Day 3. Not going to lie, I forgot I had it plugged inDay 4. I checked again, and this is what I found. The picture attached. Absolutely gross 🤢. Don’t ask, I have no idea how all these nasty little creatures lived in my sink without my knowledge. I must just be that blissfully unaware. I thought I only had a few…clearly I was wrongI’m on like Day 10 now. I waited awhile because I wanted to make sure it continued to work before posting this review. I haven’t seen another fly / gnat besides in the trap, since Day 4, nearly a week ago. Not one. However, the trap is still lit up, and still as sticky as it was on day 1.There is a faint blue glow, it’s a pretty pleasant. It’s just like a night light. It makes 0 noise whatsoever. It’s SO easy to remove and replace the sticky pad. You pull the stick piece up out of the part that attaches into the wall, and slide a new one in. So simple, yet so effective. If you’ve had these nasty little critters flying around your home for far too long now, try it. You won’t regret it. If it doesn’t work in the first spot you put it, move it around. These things supposedly come out of the drains, yet for some reason it catches far more in my bedroom outside the bathroom. So find what works for you. Also, it turns sideways if need be. So if you have a sideways plug, you can still plug it in and swivel it so it’s face up!I hope this review helps some of you choose this, and rid your life of these nasty little buggers!!

title: Actually works!
review: To start off, I have purchased this item several times. My place started to have fruit flies especially during the summer. To start off I had no clues what this was after doing some research I purchased a set to give it a try.Let me tell you within a week the Zevo light was full of fruit flies and other little bugs. This stuff definitely works.Pros: attracts basically any insects and traps them with the sticky insert. Lasts about 3-4 weeks I would say. Has a blue light that attracts the insects. Easy to use and even easier to replace inserts when it’s time. Also they are neutral looking so if guest come over nobody can see the gross insects it caught. Now that I’m thinking about it unless someone knows what it is, it looks like a plugged air freshener.Cons: honestly the only two cons I could think of is at night if you leave the Zevo lights plugged, and your eyes adjusts to the darkness. The light seems very bright, but I started to unplug them before bed so that fixes it. Lastly I wish the inserts lasted longer, they are still sticky about a month in but dust starts to settle on them and I think it’s not as sticky for the bugs.So overall I would recommend this product for your house if you are in need of an insect catcher.

title: Fabulous flying insect trapper!!
review: Living in the country, it’s inevitable that you will get a fly or two in the house with the doors opening and closing all of the time. title: Works - But Don't Expect Miracles
review: The principle of the Veyofly, utilizing a defined spectrum of light that flying insects are attracted to, assures that this device will reliably capture some flying pests.  Specifically, it seems most effective on small insects like gnats, fruit flies and mosquitos.  Whereas it is less effective attracting the common housefly.Although the Veyofly casts a bright circle (say, a bit larger than a foot in diameter) on the wall of a pleasing soft purple light, still it is no match for the bug attraction power of sunlight streaming indoors from your windows.  Specifically, in daylight, I've observed common house flies buzzing over and banging into the pane of a window that is immediately above where the Veyofly is illuminated.The problem is further compounded by the fact that house flies don't seem to be "night fliers".  For example, study what bugs swarm about over a porch light at night -- it's not black flies, but rather moths, mosquitos and tiny gnats.So, as your house becomes dark the "night flying bugs" will roam about and eventually be attracted to, and be caught, by the Veyofly.  Whereas, house flies that have parked themselves, at dusk, outside of the immediate glow of the Veyofly are much less likely to find the device, since, by my theory, they are not night fliers.However, the above aside, my two Veyoflys have indeed caught a few house flies.  But the kill rate, or effectiveness, seems like it's 10 to 1 in favor of the night fliers.  On balance, it should be noted that I do attempt to keep house flies out of the house in the first place, so my population of these pests may be low relative other bugs.Lastly, it is very important that a category of insects the Veyofly has success with are mosquitos.  For this reason alone it gets five stars.  Also, a big plus is having no stinking chemicals to deal with.  Changing out the Veyofly's "tacky card" every 2 - 3 weeks takes about 10 seconds, so maintenance is minimal.  OEM replacement tack cards on Amazon are a bit pricey, but generics at half the price are available -- no experience with the quality of the latter.

title: RECOMMEND!!! war on gnats story:
review: I have tried: Zevo Flying Insect Traps (RECOMMEND this product)Husaco Store 2 Flying Insect Traps & 2 Cartridges - Compatible with ZEVOM364A RefillKatchy Flying Insect Trap IndoorTerro Fruit Fly Traps - (RECOMMEND)I tried several products for my recent gnat/fruit fly/super tiny demons from hell infestation. I really wanted to like some, but basically overall the ZEVO was superior. Thankfully I bought that one initially, but did not realize how severe my infestation got (as I was away from home for abit). Zevo pretty immediately and quickly toned down the flying creatures, and I noticed quickly the trap filling up with more and more. A good week in it was basically all covered up.I ended up getting a total of 4 Zevo traps, in certain areas I knew would fly to at night. Night is very good at getting them. I think it helps having no other lights on  either. I will mention I also got Terro fly trap, and they are just lil tiny apple looking containers that you fill with some nasty vinegar mixture. I fill it up just a small amount, because honestly that is enough and I can keep refilling it. One I had to dump because of so many dead bodies and I refilled it up.I put one of those in my fridge just incase. And some near the other traps to try to attract them faster to the Zevo's light of death.The Katchy and offbrand zevo aka Husaco store traps, just basically didn't trap as many.... Like say a week went by and I could count the flies it was a handful. They just weren't as amazing/fast for me.I had such a drastic reduction with 2 Zevo's and now that I got 4 going, I think they might finally be eradicated. (With the Terro assists. I liked putting them by the sinks.---EDIT ---So. I was wrong. I noticed bugs before I went on another weekend trip and it was declining to a point I thought they were gone and with me being gone they were just able to breed more. This product still worked, But I needed more products for the war against the gnats.To start off. I have pets. And there is water bowl sources, litter boxes. etc.  I didn't seem to notice any issues or problems with the litter, thankfully did not need to make any changes there, maybe because I take care of it often enough.Products Used for the battle (Ill write recommended if I loved it) Over a course of 3 days I saw a drastic reduction and 4-5 days I'm having trouble finding any:More refill cartridges for this plug in -> Mistakenly thought the war ended, but these got full and I needed more.Dawn Platinum Powerwash Dish Spray, Dish Soap, Apple Scent, 16oz <- Recommended - good for dishes anyway. I sprayed inside the toilet after every flush. If they tried to breed in it, this stuff traps them and they cant fly or get out and they drown. This how you home make liquid traps, vinegar helps lure them to it. To be honest they didn't seem to care for the toilet, (which is kept shut). But I did this as precaution.Zevo Brand can spray - I stopped using because I needed alot, and it worked great kills on contact but gets used so fast, there is hardly enough in the can.  (Recommended Mighty spray below)  - also this is really expensive...Mighty Mint Peppermint Oil Insect Repellent Spray – Natural Indoor & Outdoor Bug Control for Spiders, Ants, Roaches, and More – Plant-Based, Extra-Strong Formula - 16 oz -> RECOMMENDED -> This has ALOT of spray. And it doesn't seem to kill IMMEDIATELY but wait 2-3 seconds and yeah, they stop moving. Unless you get a good clean direct close up shot. Was also nice, to spray them on the wall, they would immediately fall off.  PLUS you get to one on one gnats and take 'em down right where you see them.  I'd go around to windows and doors, and find them there. Pew, pew. Bit satisfying. And smell isn't so bad, but can be strong. In the heat of battle you might be overwhelmed. I'd take a break from the area, get a fan etc. Smell will dissipate eventually/gradually.Sticky traps, the yellow that has a tack and hangs from wall -40 Pack Fruit Fly Traps for Indoor, Fly Traps Outdoor, Sticky Fly Trap Strips Tape Killer Catcher Paper Ribbon, Flying Insect Trap for Bug, Gnat, Insect, Pest, Mosquito -> RECOMMENDED -> Good passive attack. These are useful in variety of spots. Gnats tend to scale the walls and go up to the ceiling where these bad boys come in handy.  I had one just in the wall not ceiling but high up so pets cant get to it. Was collecting quiet a few.TERRO Drain Insect Killer - T590 Drain Fly Killer Spray - Foam Treatment for Fruit Flies, House Flies, and CockroachesAlso Green Gobbler drain killer. -> (recommend)  I used the gobbler first, frankly I think both work and wil do the job. But this is a plus that it foams right up (not for long mind you) but  I did notice gnats gravitate towards it and immediately die.  What you need to do is use this stuff and then PLUG the holes. see below + more info.Aluvor Bathtub Stopper 2pcs Sink Stopper Tub Plug Bathroom Shower Drain Plug Silicone Bathtub Drain Plug Tub Drain Stopper Washbasin Stopper - RECOMMENDED - Now this is why I think I got away with one can of the foam. I didn't really need to reapply, but I did as precaution.  For sink, plug the tiny hole with tape, its a backup hole for overflow, most sinks should have it if not you are good. Then use the tiny one for the bathroom sink. And the other one for the tub. I closed off the sink and mostly used the bathroom sink as my main source for washing/cleaning things. I did notice a fly or two come out during this but they seem dazed and was easily able to hand kill them. I'd be ready to spray them down. After I was done and wasn't going to use a drain for awhile I'd foam it up again. So depending on this factor you might want more foam. (I didn't run out of the can yet, so can't say for sure). Either way if it is sealed up you have time to buy more if needed.No product found for kitchen sink drain blocker/stopper -> I had bought one but it didnt actually block. I ended up using a plastic throwaway cup and weighed it down with a can for good measure, pretty sure they don't have ant strength to come and go. And the other sink for disposal I had a sink stopper already which blocked that side completely. I sprayed the foam in both and tried to avoid using the sink.Wondercide - Fruit Fly Traps for Indoors - Fruit Fly Killer - Pet and People Safe - Made in USA & Plant Based - 5.4 oz - 2 Pack -> PLUS has a cover lid on top, pets might knock it over but can't step into it. I would see gnats crawling on top of it quite often. Just checked and imo these did as well as the raid one below. Double for less money I thought it was. And has a cover on it with holes for the bugs to go in.Raid Essentials Fruit Fly Trap for Indoors, Made with Essential Oils, Child and Pet Safe, 5.4 oz -> This worked it was catching ALOT. However my cat, stepped his back foot in it somehow, and it wasn't knocked over. I have no IDEA how this happened but I had to wash his leg off. This DID work well. You could see a layer of gnats forming on the top quickly.  - The expensiveness of this mixed with not being great around pets I can't recommend.I DO recommend those terro fruit fly traps that looks like red apples. Those are effective always have been. Thats my standard go to when I notice these usually from bananas. also not to expensive.Trash can with a LID -> I had ONE trash can with a LID so it was closed. I would use to throw stuff away in and took that outside often so they couldn't sneak in and have a party.  Hefty actually has one with a GOOD seal. However, I was unable to obtain the item as my local store had it in stock but it was damaged and had a hole on the side of the can.... So I settled for a regular lid that wasn't fully sealed but had a button to open it and I'd just close it after.  (Hefty Touch Lid  is the name). It was helpful for the cause. I think most have a trash can with a lid but if not it is highly RECOMMENDED.-- WHAT you need to check --Water sources, bowls etc. Pet bowls of water. pet FOUNTAINS. Need to be cleaned at least 1x every 24 hour period. Personally if I saw them sitting on anything I'd clean that immediately. I never saw them on the pet  fountain but when I  checked I saw so much in the filter it was gross. I didn't use the fountain at all until after I won the war. (Just too gross and I wouldn't feel comfortable using the same filter, so I opted to not use it at all).Look around for exploded water jugs you may have kept for emergencies. Those explode and leak all the time. Found out the hard way.After taking care of the drains and constant cleaning pet water sources, these guys disappeared. Finally.Bananas are no longer welcome.

title: It Actually Works...
review: Well it doesn't get rid of the fly that is buzzing around your head... But overnight it catches flies!I used this last summer and with warm weather coming in April, I've pulled out my units to use again this summer. So I'm impressed with Vevo. And thankfully we don't get lots of flies, but then there are days when there are too many, especially on very hot days. I guess flies like air-conditioning! Lol!***Just remember that the Vevo trap works best overnight and only when the room is dark, so the light can lure the fly into the trap...  And then the pesky thing won't bother you anymore! At 1st I didn't think it was working, but then I checked each trap and it had snared it's prey, so to say. About a week and a half later, I checked them again and here were my findings.- Unit 1 is by our partly glass back door and it  caught 2 flies. It's plugged in under our bay window and is about 10 feet from a lamp that stays on all night.  ***Vevo says light will possibly deter flies from the catcher. You see, the trap uses an ultra violet light with a cover (for human and pet eye safety), so if you have other light sources then the fly may go to those lights.- Unit 2 is in the kitchen, on an upper plug above an unused counter, that is almost in a corner and is not far from our covered kitchen trash can. This unit had 6 flies! So the darker area and the location being nearer to the trashcan (fly restaurant), lured more flies to it, thus removing the pests from buzzing around me and my family.***This is way better than fly tape that is nasty and looks disgusting. Plus I don't have to touch the sticky area or the flies in order to dispose of them. That said, I'm waiting until more flies come to their demise before tossing the liner. Unfortunately, the liners are expensive! Admittedly they are on a frame with a holder, which is what makes this sanitary and less icky. So to me, it's worth the price. Plus there are some generic brand refill cartridges available on Amazon if you want to pay a lower price... (Just be careful of which refill you choose and of what shop. Amazon is full of poor quality items, but there are gems among the rubble.) Now these are not decorative, but they are not bad looking either. The soft light they cast onto the wall is kinda nice. Plus I only use these in the summer and they are small enough to put away during the winter, making them cost effective.So what is my verdict?2 Vevo units, including some refill cartridges and the occasional use of a fly swatter is all I need during the summer to get rid of annoying flies.*** So I highly recommend this product! It gets rid of flies while I sleep, so there are less or all gone the next day. That said, when the back door opens to let our pups in and out, all day long... more flies arrive, so I'm glad Vevo makes such a good product that is simple to use and reliable.So if you have flies buzzing around you and your family, then this product will get rid of them while everyone is sleeping. And clean up is simple and sanitary. Try it! You will enjoy summer better!

title: WOW!!!
review: My husband and I just moved into a very old apartment building over this winter, and as it’s warmed up into spring we’ve realized we have a bad gnat problem here as not everything is sealed as well as it could be. While this doesn’t treat the root problem of course, these trap plug-ins have been game changing as far as managing the flies. Three days after plugging in the two units we got to start with, we have hardly noticed any at all. This picture shows one of the traps which was placed in the worst problem area after just three days. I was shocked at how well just a little blue light works. I was skeptical at first seeing these online, but they work remarkably well and setting them up took less than a minute. We may end up purchasing another pair for maximum efficiency but so far even just the two we have have worked wonders. If you’re skeptical like I was, do yourself a favor and just hit add to cart.

title: They work! 12 flies overnight! NOT A GIMMICK THEY ACTUALLY WORK!

review: I purchased the Zevo flying insect trap for my garage this winter. I was very impressed with the number of small flying insects it trapped on the glue paper trap. It was very effective. review: I used this to deal with a phorid fly / drain fly situation.It is not some instant bug apocalypse machine, but the sticky cards definitely showed that it was doing its job. title: You will NOT regret this purchase. Buy as many plug ins as you can afford!
